lead.headline: No claim tonight; Tuten out of the FLEX before Thursday
lead.deck: Claims close at 02:00 and nothing on the wire is worth season-long priority. Tuten missed a second practice; Taylor and Jacobs still have no dates.
lead.body: The bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten, in the FLEX, did not appear to practise Tuesday after a Monday DNP with the ankle and foot, and locks into that slot at Thursday's 19:15 CDMX kickoff. Jonathan Taylor is still the top name on the trade market with the deadline on 10 Nov, after Week 9 (Heavy 3 Nov), and the league's review of Josh Jacobs has no ruling (PFR 2 Nov). On the wire, the answer for tonight's last waiver run is no claim: Allgeier inherits a hurt Love's job in Arizona and Mike Washington Jr. took Jeanty's carries by Kubiak's design, but neither would start here and IPADE priority never resets. The moves are three coin flips on the roster — Gordon for Tuten before Thursday, Rice and Likely before Sunday.
